notes.title: Version 2.4 - Update Notes
notes.content:
In this update, we have added two new languages to the game: Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese. Additionally, minor adjustments have been made to optimize the gameplay experience:

Complete translation of dialogue texts, weapons, skills, statuses, and parts of the RPG Maker MZ HUD.
Note 1:
Due to differences in writing systems, languages, and cultures, the translation may not be perfect and could contain errors. We welcome any feedback to help us improve in future updates.

Note 2:
It is recommended to start a new game to avoid potential compatibility issues with this update.

We sincerely appreciate your feedback and continued support.

Sincerely,
ExoFiroGames

notes.title: Version 2.3 - Update Notes
notes.content:
This update includes a few improvements and minor adjustments to enhance the gameplay experience:

-Fixed several text issues.
-The CG Room option has been relocated.
-Updated the VisuStella image plugin and added an option in the house book to manually attempt to fix the error if it reappears.
-Changed the name "Rock" to "Large Stone" to avoid confusion.
-Made some small additional adjustments to improve gameplay.

I sincerely thank everyone for your ongoing feedback and support.

Note: It is recommended to start a new game to avoid potential errors with the update.

Sincerely,
ExoFiroGames

notes.title: Version 2.2 Announcement
notes.content:
This update includes some improvements and minor adjustments:

[b]Small decrease in the stats of Elira and the Hippogriff:[/b] To make the encounter a bit easier.
[b]Decrease in Ulula's evasion stat:[/b] To make the combat more accessible.
[b]Adjustment in the unlocking of the gallery in the Room CGs:[/b] Now unlocks progressively upon meeting each girl for the first time.
[b]New option in the house clock:[/b] For those who want to instantly regenerate map resources (available after the initial tutorial).

I would like to thank everyone for their feedback and support.

Note: It is always recommended to start a new game to avoid errors with the update.

Sincerely,
[b]ExoFiroGames[/b]

notes.title: Update Version 2.1 Announcement
notes.content:
This update includes several accessibility improvements and minor issue fixes:

[b]Mobility:[/b] You can now move using the WASD keys in addition to the arrow keys.

[b]Auto-attack Improvement:[/b] We updated the Visustella plugin for counterattacks.

[b]Autosave[/b]: We modified the autosave feature to prevent the game from saving at inopportune moments.

[b]Updated Guide[/b]: A small dialogue has been added to encourage the player to upgrade their equipment at a necessary point in the adventure.

[b]Hidden TP Bar[/b]: The TP bar has been hidden since it has no use in this game and caused confusion.

[b]Unlocked Room CGs[/b]: The content of the Room CGs is now unlocked from the beginning.

[b]Dojo Message[/b]: A message has been added to inform the player when the dojo is available again.

[b]Minor Fixes[/b]: Various minor fixes have been made to improve the gameplay experience.

I would like to thank everyone for their feedback and support.


Sincerely,
[b]ExoFiroGames[/b]

Note: It is always recommended to start a new game to avoid errors with the update.
